title: Depression – Education, Prevention and Recovery Support
summary: In the project, patients from BKH Augsburg are included regardless of their illness to capture depressive symptoms throughout the study, both during their stay and after discharge. Patients are accompanied with digital questionnaires and contacted at regular intervals. The aim is to identify risk factors for more severe courses and relapses based on the collected data.

interventions.name: Digital survey of patients admitted to BKH Augsburg, either inpatient, outpatient, or semi-stationary, conducted during their hospital stay as well as at 14 days, 28 days, 90 days, and then every 3 months (for a maximum of 2 years) after the initial survey.
